title: fix(app-shell): the record page disables Edit when the record's state leaves its edit form nothing to edit
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D7W3VkbCqRfhBeMnkWzQ5fW)_

Fixes #32756

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:记录页上,当记录当前状态让编辑表单的每个字段都被 `readonlyWhen` 锁成只读时,「编辑」按钮置灰,旁边出现琥珀色徽标「当前状态下不可编辑」;行内编辑铅笔同步关闭。
- 为什么改:已批准的报销单上「编辑」仍可点,打开后全是只读字段、「更新」点了无效,让用户误以为能改。
- 风险与回滚:只读判定复用表单自己的求值器与系统字段过滤,任一字段可写、谓词出错、表单视图带子表时都保持原样(放开);回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`ui/packages/app-shell/src/utils/editFormLockedByState.ts`(判定条件)、`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.tsx` 中 `editLockedByState` 三处(按钮 disabled、徽标、行内铅笔)。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.editLockedByState-32756.test.tsx`,预期 4 条全绿。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- New `editFormLockedByState(objectDef, record, scope)` in `@object-ui/app-shell` utils. It answers "does this record's state leave the edit form nothing to edit?" with the form's own pieces: `filterSystemFields` from `@object-ui/plugin-form` (the fields the form draws: platform-managed, `hidden` and static `readonly` fields dropped) and `resolveFieldRuleState` from `@object-ui/core` (each field's `visibleWhen` / `readonlyWhen` verdict, over the stored record seeded the way the form seeds it, with the same predicate scope). No predicate is evaluated a second way.
- It answers `true` only when every drawn, visible field resolves read-only AND at least one of them is locked by its `readonlyWhen`. It fails open (Edit stays as today) when any drawn field is writable, when only static flags or server-computed fields make the form read-only, when the edit form view declares `subforms`, and when a predicate faults.
- `RecordDetailView`: `sys_edit`'s `disabled` becomes `approvalLocked || editDisabledByPredicate || editLockedByState`; the inline-edit `canEdit` joins the same verdict (the file's stated header/pencil mirror); a `role="status"` badge in the page's shared chrome says "Not editable in its current state" while the state lock holds and no approval lock is already explaining the disabled Edit. The `page:header` renderer draws a disabled reason for authored actions only, so the host draws this one beside the header, as the DetailView lock band does for the approval lock.
- `@object-ui/i18n`: one added key, `detail.lockedByState`, in all eleven locale packs (Clause-② yes, widening).
- Changeset: `@object-ui/app-shell` patch, `@object-ui/i18n` patch.

## Tests

- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/utils/editFormLockedByState.test.ts` (10): locked by `readonlyWhen`; array field spelling; predicate false; one writable field; hidden / `visibleWhen`-hidden writable fields ignored; server-computed fields read-only but never the state lock; static-readonly-only object stays live; faulting predicate fails open; `subforms` stays live; no def / no record.
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.editLockedByState-32756.test.tsx` (4): every field locked → Edit disabled + the reason badge; CONTROL one writable field → Edit enabled, no badge; CONTROL draft state → Edit enabled; approval lock unchanged (locking approvals read: Edit disabled, only the lock band speaks, both for a writable and a state-locked record).

## Acceptance notes

- The verdict reads the object's whole field map, a superset of a curated form view's sections, so a writable field outside the sections keeps Edit live (fail-open). Field-level write permissions are not part of this verdict (the card is `readonlyWhen`); a record whose fields are all read-only by permission alone keeps today's behaviour.
- Browser check on the console's record-header preview harness (stub data source, the card's object and predicate): full page and drawer at 1280 px and a 390 px phone; the badge sits above the action row without overlapping it, Edit disabled; draft state shows Edit enabled and no badge.
